title: Appeals and Grievances: First-Level Outcome and the Amount Taken to Formal Review on a TRICARE Select Line
content:
## Appeals and Grievances: what part of the payment at issue goes up to formal review

Scope: a formal review asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

**Clause.** What part of the payment at issue is carried up depends on what the first level already did with the case's line: where the case was decided partially overturned and a paid corrected posting of the same service date on the same claim has been made, the amount carried is the payment at issue less the TRICARE payment on that corrected posting, never below zero and rounded to the cent; where the case's line has been reversed as a duplicate claim and no paid corrected posting exists, nothing is carried; in every other case the whole payment at issue is carried.

**Records read.** The case's own decision status; the TRICARE Select postings of the same claim with the same service date as the case's line whose line outcome is paid — the corrected posting, and where there is more than one, the most recently posted, whose TRICARE payment is used (a corrected posting exists when that TRICARE payment is above zero); and any reversal posting of the case's line whose reversal reason is duplicate claim.

| Case decided partially overturned | Paid corrected posting with a TRICARE payment | Line reversed as a duplicate claim | Amount carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | payment at issue less the corrected posting's TRICARE payment, never below zero |
| yes | no | yes | nothing (0.00) |
| no | no | yes | nothing (0.00) |
| no | yes | yes | the whole payment at issue |
| yes or no | no | no | the whole payment at issue |
| no | yes | no | the whole payment at issue |

**Hypothetical figures** (payment at issue 256.00):

- Decided partially overturned; corrected posting paid 180.00 by TRICARE: 256.00 less 180.00, carried 76.00.
- Decided partially overturned; corrected posting paid 300.00: 256.00 less 300.00 would be below zero, so 0.00 is carried.
- Decided upheld; the line was reversed as a duplicate claim and no paid corrected posting exists: nothing is carried.
- Decided upheld; no reversal and no corrected posting: the whole 256.00 is carried.
